# Temple Scroll Column 44 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 44 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**44:1** You shall not eat any detestable thing. These are the living things that you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.

**44:2** Every animal that has a divided hoof — a split into two hooves — and that brings up the cud among the animals — that you may eat.

**44:3** Nevertheless, these you shall not eat among those that bring up the cud or among those that have a divided hoof: the camel, for it brings up the cud but does not have a divided hoof — it is unclean to you.

**44:4** And the rock badger, for it brings up the cud but does not have a divided hoof — it is unclean to you.

**44:5** And the hare, for it brings up the cud but does not have a divided hoof — it is unclean to you.

**44:6** Every animal that has a divided hoof, making a split into two hooves, and that chews the cud among the animals — that you may eat.

**44:7** But these you shall not eat: the camel, the hare, and the rock badger — for they chew the cud but do not have a divided hoof; they are unclean to you.

**44:8** And the pig — though it has a divided hoof, making a split of the hoof, yet it does not chew the cud — it is unclean to you.

**44:9** You shall not eat of their flesh, and their carcasses you shall not touch; they are unclean to you.

**44:10** These you may eat of all that are in the waters: everything that has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas and in the rivers — them you may eat.

**44:11** And the pig — though it has a divided hoof, it does not chew the cud; it is unclean to you; you shall not eat of their flesh and their carcasses you shall not touch.

**44:12** And everything in the waters that does not have fins and scales — it is detestable to you; you shall not eat of them.

**44:13** You shall not eat any creature that has died of itself; you may give it to the sojourner who is within your gates, and he shall eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner.

**44:14** For you are a holy people to the LORD your God; and the LORD has chosen you to be a treasured people to himself out of all the peoples that are on the face of the earth.

**44:15** You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

**44:16** These are the statutes and the judgments that you shall observe to do in the land that I give you as a possession all the days that you live upon the earth.

---

*EMET notes: Column 44 presents the dietary laws paralleling Deuteronomy 14:3-21 and Leviticus 11:1-23. The dual criteria for clean land animals (split hoof + cud-chewing) are stated twice (vv. 2, 6), with specific exceptions listed. The pig prohibition (vv. 8, 11) receives double emphasis. The kid-in-milk prohibition (v. 15) concludes the dietary section. The carrion rule (v. 13) follows Deuteronomy 14:21.*
